load_pipeline_pixart: load a PixArt-Alpha diffusion pipeline with configurable compilation, quantization, and dtype options
apply_dynamic_quant_transformer: apply dynamic int8 quantization to transformer linear layers using a filter function
swap_conv2d_1x1_to_linear: swap 1x1 convolutional layers to linear operations for better torch.compile performance
enable_fused_qkv_projections: enable fused QKV projections for both transformer and VAE components
compile_diffusion_components: compile transformer and VAE decode with torch.compile using max-autotune mode
